description: This Java class 'LocationTagEditor' extends a generic property editor to handle 'LocationTag' objects. It provides methods to retrieve 'LocationTag' instances by their ID or UUID, integrating with the OpenMRS context's location service.

classes.name: LocationTagEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for LocationTag objects, enabling retrieval by ID or UUID.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag object by its integer ID.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag object by its UUID string.
